Name: Transformers MTMTE - Rung
Author: XnixnBvg
Description:
[quote][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS][size=1]﻿"Here's a little—whatever. A little thing. A disclosure. An insight. Revisionism—I've always been fascinated by it. By the idea of a writer going back and altering things. Make no mistake: an edit is a profoundly aggressive act. As Froid once said, we grieve for the murdered word. If you want to get the measure of an author, don't look at what they've left on the page.... look at what they've taken away”[/size][/font][/color][/quote][font=Comic Sans MS][size=6]
[/size][/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ff0000][size=6]My first ever Mod! [/size][/color]

[/b][size=1]This mod brings [color=#ff7700]Rung [/color]from Transformers More Than Meets The Eye to SDV, its still a wip, and bugs are bound to happen. This mod is the first and one of the few mods I have planned to involve the MTMTE Transformers and will be a new expansion involving them. However, I will need help on doing so. Rung is found in Harvey's Clinic, mostly in his room, you cannot enter Harvey's room unless you're good friends with him or have the Key to the Town.[/size][/font][/center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff0000][size=6][b]Features:[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#000000][size=4]- Adds Rung as a dateable NPC and Marriage!
- Custom Dialogue!
[/size][/color][color=#000000][size=4]- Tries to stay canon to both SDV and MTMTE[/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=6][b]Planned Features:[/b]
[/size][/color]
[color=#000000][size=4]- Child related Dialogue.
-  Child Interactions 
- Expanding his room and Patio 
- Add more dialogue 
[/size][/color][color=#000000][size=4]- Heart Events[/size]
[size=4]- Adding The Ship Where the MTMTE cast lives
[/size][size=4]- Commission someone to make custom portraits. 
[/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=6][b]Known Bugs:[/b]
[/size][/color][size=4]
[color=#000000]- Rung sometimes disappears, it happened once before a event he was gone for two days. I wrote it off as him visiting The Lost Light. (He'll be gone for two days before the festivals.) He will return on the day of the festival, I only ran into this bug on the 24th and 25th of Fall. I'm not sure for the others however. 
- Smapi Log will say "Bad Gift Taste Data For Rung!" I don't know how to fix that, until then it's a permanent thing. 
- One of his portraits $blush does not show as there isn't any blush pictures as the portrait sprites were all pulled from the comics as I cannot draw faces for him.
- Rung sometimes won't have Dialogue when married, when you click on him, he doesn't say anything (Sometimes gives you stuff), the dialogue box will close.[/color][color=#000000][center]- His spouse room is glitched, if you right click, you will be able to sit down and I cannot fix it until then.
